mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO outbox_event (topic, msg_key, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES
(#{item.topic}, #{item.msgKey}, #{item.payload}::jsonb, #{item.status}, #{item.attempts}, COALESCE(#{item.nextAttemptAt}, NOW()), #{item.createdBy}, #{item.updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, msg_key AS msgKey, payload::text AS payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt, sent_at AS sentAt FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE outbox_event SET attempts = #{attempts}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'SENT' AND sent_at < #{before}
